sources.title: FOSSGIS OSRM car ordered-waypoint candidates
sources.notes: Serial maintenance requests only, maximum one request per second. Generic car profile does not prove passenger operations, bus legality or complete turn restrictions. OSM vintage not exposed. Engine distances are not observed transit times. See generation_report.json for withheld matches, offsets and per-leg road sequences.
